blocks.text: Electrostatics ya static electricity (saakin bijli) un cheezon ka mutala hai jo ruke hue (stationary) electric charges se paida hoti hain. Is mein charges ki aik doosre par force, un ka banaya hua electric field aur electric potential, aur khali jagah (space) aur mukhtalif aalaat (devices) mein jama hone wali electrical energy shamil hai.

Hum parh chuke hain ke har charge apne ird gird electric field banata hai. Is field mein koi doosra charge rakhein to us par force lagti hai. Is electrostatic force ki miqdar Coulomb's law se nikalti hai:

Is force ki simt (direction) charges ki qisam par munhasir hai: dono positive ya dono negative hon to woh aik doosre ko dhakelte (repel) hain, aik positive aur aik negative ho to kheenchte (attract) hain. Is chapter mein hum parhenge ke charge apne field ke kisi nuqte (point) par kitna electric potential banata hai. Phir dekhenge ke electrical energy aur charge aik aam device, capacitor, mein kaise jama hote hain, aur capacitors ke kuch ahem istemal (uses) bhi parhenge.

blocks.prompt: Coulomb's law kya batata hai, aur force ki simt kis cheez par munhasir hai?
blocks.explanation: Do point charges q₁ aur q₂ ke darmiyan electrostatic force Fₑ = (1/4πε₀)(q₁q₂/r²) hai, yani charges ke hasil-e-zarb ke barabar aur faasle ke square ke ulat (inversely) mutabiq. Simt charges ki qisam par munhasir hai: aik jaise charges repel aur mukhtalif charges attract karte hain.

items: Electrostatics: ruke hue charges, un ki force, field, potential aur jama energy.
Is chapter mein: electric potential, capacitor aur us ke istemal.
